status.title: Status
status.name: Name
status.zones_writable: zone dnsapi may use ({full} in full, {assigned} assigned) | zones dnsapi may use ({full} in full, {assigned} assigned)
status.not_configured_title: The API is not published yet
status.not_configured_description: Set its host name in Settings to publish it.
status.no_zones_title: dnsapi may not use any zone yet
status.no_zones_description: On dnshelper's Access page, add a rule for module/{module} on the zones the API may manage: the "API module (all records)" preset for a customer's whole zone, or the ACME preset for certificate validation only.

settings.title: Settings
settings.host_helper: Clients reach the API at https://<host name>/v1/. It needs a DNS record pointing to this node, and must not be used by another application.
settings.lets_encrypt_tooltip: The host name must resolve to this node from the internet, and port 80 must be reachable, for the certificate to be issued.
settings.ip_allowlist_helper: One IP address or CIDR network per line. Traefik refuses every other client. Leave empty to allow any address.
settings.host_is_not_valid_not_localhost: Enter a fully qualified host name
settings.newcert_acme_error: Let's Encrypt did not issue a certificate for this host name
settings.bad_ip_address: Not a valid IP address or network: {value}
settings.pattern: Enter a fully qualified host name
settings.rate_limit_helper: DNS requests per minute for each key. Reads count too, because they count against the DNS host's own limits.

action.list-assignable-zones: List the zones dnsapi may use

error.zone_assigned: The zone belongs to another tenant
error.zone_not_assignable: dnshelper does not let dnsapi write in this zone
error.zone_not_assigned: The zone is not assigned to this tenant
error.invalid_expiry: Not a date in the future

zones.unavailable_dnshelper_missing: dnshelper is not installed. dnsapi changes DNS records only through dnshelper.
zones.unavailable_dnshelper_too_old: dnshelper is older than 0.7.0 and does not say which zones dnsapi may use. Update it.
zones.unavailable_unavailable: dnshelper did not answer. Try again later.

tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.intro: A tenant is one of your customers. Each zone belongs to at most one tenant, and a tenant's keys reach only its own zones. Your billing portal can manage tenants itself with an operator key.
tenants.name: Name
tenants.name_helper: For example the customer's name. Only shown to you and to the operator's portal.
tenants.enabled_tooltip: The keys of a disabled tenant are refused until it is enabled again.
tenants.zones_helper: The zones dnshelper lets dnsapi write in that no other tenant has. "Some records": dnshelper allows only part of the zone, such as ACME challenges.
tenants.no_zones_to_assign: No zone is available. On dnshelper's Access page, add a rule for this module on the zones the API may manage.
tenants.save_failed: The tenant could not be saved
tenants.no_tenants_description: Add a tenant for each customer whose zones the API manages, or for systems that validate certificates.
tenants.remove_description: {name} and its {keys} keys will be removed, and its zones unassigned. The records in its zones are not changed. The keys stop working at once.

keys.title: Keys
keys.intro: An operator key reaches every zone dnsapi may use and manages tenants and their keys: it is the key for a billing portal. A tenant key reaches only that tenant's zones. Keys are shown once, when they are made.
keys.label: Label
keys.label_helper: What the key is for, such as "Billing portal" or "host1 certificates"
keys.restrict_helper: Limit the key to some records of its zones. A limited key cannot manage tenants and keys.
keys.restrict_names_helper: Relative to the zone, separated by commas; * and ? are wildcards, @ is the zone itself
keys.restrict_types_helper: Record types separated by commas; empty for every type
keys.allowlist_helper: One IP address or network per line. Empty: any address.
keys.expires_helper: Optional: the key stops working at the start of this day (UTC).
keys.shown_once_description: It is shown only this once: dnsapi keeps only a fingerprint of it. If it is lost, revoke it and create another.
keys.created_how: Send it as "Authorization: Bearer <key>" to {url}. ACME clients use it as their password.
keys.no_crypto: This browser cannot make a key here: the page must be opened over HTTPS.
keys.no_keys_description: Create an operator key for a billing portal, or a key for a tenant.
keys.revoke_description: The key {label} of {owner} stops working at once. This cannot be undone.

activity.title: Activity
activity.intro: The most recent changes: records changed through the API, and tenants, zones and keys changed through the API or here. Reads are not listed. The log of every request is in the cluster's Logs page.
activity.no_activity_description: Changes appear here as they are made.
activity.action_prune_zone: Dropped a zone dnshelper no longer allows
